segments.name: Acquiring and managing royalty interests
segments.description: Acquires and manages royalty interests on producing, development and exploration-stage mining properties operated by third parties.
segments.evidence: The Company's business is organized into two operating segments, consisting of (i) acquiring and managing royalty interests, and (ii) acquiring and managing streams and other interests.

segments.name: Acquiring and managing streams and other interests
segments.description: Acquires and manages stream and other interests, including gold purchase agreements acquired from Deterra Royalties in 2025.
segments.evidence: Prior to September 26, 2025, the Company presented one reportable segment, consisting of acquiring and managing royalty interests.

revenueModel.text: Third-party mine operators pay Vox royalties and stream income based on production from the underlying mines, with Vox purchasing gold under PMPAs at market-referenced prices and capturing margin on resale.
revenueModel.evidence: Under the terms of these agreements, Vox purchases a defined percentage of payable gold at a dynamic price that is typically set by market reference prices (LBMA or COMEX) and grants the ability to Vox to capture margin at the time of on-sale of metal on each delivered ounce.
